title: KeySet
description: The published public-key set with rotation history, as returned by GET /v1/receipts/keys in SPEC.md. Verifiers resolve a receipt's key_id against this set.

key_id.description: Stable identifier referenced by a receipt's key_id.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Only ed25519 is defined in v0.1.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key (32 raw bytes), base64url-encoded without padding.

status.description: Whether the key may still be trusted. A revoked key yields the `revoked` verification result.

not_before.description: Earliest issuance time this key signed for.

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked. Present only when status is "revoked".
